channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-mac
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: PitchTap — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar app that changes the key of any app's audio live without changing the tempo.

item.title: Nearby Drop — via awesome-mac
item.description: Independent macOS menu-bar app for two-way Google Quick Share transfers with compatible Android devices, plus USB MTP, Finder sharing, QR tools, and experimental Windows interoperability.

item.title: Konverter — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar file converter and image compressor operated by dragging files onto a radial wheel.

item.title: Healthy Battery — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source charge limiter with live power flow and long-term battery health for Apple Silicon MacBooks.

item.title: Godmode Bot — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source AI coworker that turns your Claude subscription into persistent agents that do computer work in their own browser with your logins.

item.title: Folderglass — via awesome-mac
item.description: Quick Look extension for folders: real size including subfolders, file-type breakdown, largest and newest files, git branch and status, and the README rendered inline. Also previews zip contents and Markdown.

item.title: FinchGram — via awesome-mac
item.description: Unofficial open-source Telegram client built on TDLib, with a screenshot tool, WebDAV downloads and opt-in MCP access for AI assistants.

item.title: DockFlip — via awesome-mac
item.description: Dock window lists with browser tabs, a Flip 3D ⌘Tab window switcher and Windows-style snapping in one app.

item.title: CoWork OS — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source desktop AI agent for files, browser, and chat-app tasks that works with your own API keys or local models.

item.title: Clippo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Clipboard history with search, saved snippet lists and a paste queue that pastes copied items one by one. Skips passwords, history encrypted on disk.

item.title: Archivator — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar archive tool that compresses and extracts files by dragging them onto a radial wheel.

item.title: Voltip — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source push-to-talk dictation with on-device or cloud recognition, AI polish, and a paired Android phone as an optional microphone.

item.title: SpaceMap — via awesome-mac
item.description: Disk usage analyzer that draws your disk as a nested treemap you can zoom into, filling in live while the scan runs.

item.title: MD QuickLook — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native Quick Look extension for Markdown with syntax highlighting, math, and Mermaid diagrams, without a web engine.

item.title: Kumquat — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar file converter: drag files, tap Shift and drop them on a wheel to convert images, audio, video and documents, compress, OCR, trim and annotate.

item.title: KiwiDesk — via awesome-mac
item.description: Tiling window manager that works out of the box with no config file, has a native Settings app, and updates itself from inside the app.

item.title: IconCraft — via awesome-mac
item.description: Give any Mac app the name and icon you already know. The app underneath does not change.

item.title: ClawTank — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source RDP server for connecting to a Mac from standard Remote Desktop clients like Windows App and mstsc.

item.title: AI Canvas Tauri — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free, lightweight, source-available AI canvas for storyboarding, image and video creation, editing, and asset management with ComfyUI workflows.

item.title: Shiyin — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source meeting recorder that transcribes on-device, identifies speakers, and writes timestamped notes with your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

item.title: Perch — via awesome-mac
item.description: Keyboard-first MacBook notch app for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi sessions: see what each did, answer from the notch, and jump back to the exact window or terminal pane.

item.title: Optics Framework — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source UI test automation for Android, iOS, web and smart TV apps, with tests written as CSV or YAML steps.

item.title: Frink — via awesome-mac
item.description: Desktop-first, open-source (MIT) application for running parallel agents, and multi-step custom workflows triggered by schedules, webhooks or events from tools like Linear and Sentry, across your already-used providers.

item.title: Fotohaus — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source photo organizer that works on your existing folders, with on-device face recognition, search and non-destructive editing.

item.title: Convertino — via awesome-mac
item.description: Drag a file, tap Shift and drop it on a radial menu to convert or edit it.

item.title: Borne — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native front end for MAME and classic PC games (Doom, Quake, Duke Nukem 3D), in the spirit of MAMEUI, with the emulator and engines included.

item.title: Enconvo — via awesome-mac
item.description: AI agent that understands your screen and completes tasks across apps.

item.title: DBine — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source database manager for 130+ SQL and NoSQL databases and cloud services, with notebooks, schema and data compare, and an MCP server.

item.title: Cove — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source native composer, session sidebar and diff viewer for Claude Code and Codex, currently available as an Apple Silicon preview.

item.title: Threadlines — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source desktop app for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor), where several agents can share one thread and each thread gets its own git worktree.

item.title: TetherCam — via awesome-mac
item.description: Use an iPhone as a USB camera on a Mac for video only, or use the OBS plugin for video and the phone's microphone audio.

item.title: SSHFire — via awesome-mac
item.description: Cross-platform SSH client with a terminal, a session manager and an SFTP browser that follows the current directory.

item.title: Mac Android Subsystem — via awesome-mac
item.description: Run Android apps on Apple Silicon, each in its own Mac window with its own Dock icon.

item.title: Eleven — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source reverse-engineering app where coding agents read, rename and patch binaries, Android apps and GPU kernels alongside you.

item.title: Peel — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free, open source uninstaller and cleaner that removes apps with every file they leave behind, shows you why each file belongs, and moves everything to the Trash, so you can put it back.

item.title: mFix — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source window manager with keyboard and drag snapping, snap layouts, a Cmd+Tab window switcher with live previews, and Dock window previews.

item.title: Textus — via awesome-mac
item.description: WYSIWYG Markdown editor with math, tables, Mermaid and an optional AI writing assistant that works with cloud or local models.

item.title: Panoply — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free file tools that run on your computer: PDF, images, video and audio, OCR, ID photos, instant file search and a disk map.

item.title: OpenScreen — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source tool for creating polished screen demos and walkthrough videos.

item.title: Octuo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Personal assistant for work across AI, tools and specialist services that coordinates connected, authorized tools and accounts, tracks progress and gathers results around your goal.

item.title: NotchMuse — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source synced lyrics for Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and Soda Music in the menu bar, beside the notch, or above the Dock.

item.title: MagicWall — via awesome-mac
item.description: Set local videos as desktop wallpapers.

item.title: Dynamic Menu Bar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Changes the color and shape of the macOS menu bar with live screen-matched colors, gradients, a music visualizer and per-app profiles.

item.title: Dimble — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar manager built for macOS 27's rebuilt menu bar. Hides the icons you don't need until you do.

item.title: Local Transcriber — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that records calls and meetings and transcribes them on-device with Whisper, with speaker recognition, call detection and dictation into any app.

item.title: Strata Files — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source file manager and Finder alternative with instant search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map and dual pane.

item.title: Siliconed — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app for local AI image generation and instruction-based image editing on Apple silicon, written in Swift and Metal.

item.title: Photo Review — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source tool that lists an iCloud Photos library by size, then compresses large videos or deletes what you pick.

item.title: LawPulse — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local-first legal research tool for Chinese lawyers: offline statute library with per-article notes; all data stays on your Mac.

item.title: JoeBro — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native SwiftUI workspace for chat and document editing with local models via Ollama or any API, plus memory, MCP tools, and deep research.
